item_short_desc: Rothco’s Zipper First Aid Kit is a compact and convenient solution for emergency medical needs, containing 20 essential first aid supplies. The heavy-duty canvas pouch features a U-shaped zipper opening for quick and easy access to the contents inside. Designed with a belt loop attachment, this first aid kit can be worn on your belt, allowing for hands-free carry and swift access while on the go.
description: Rothco’s Zipper First Aid Kit is a compact and convenient solution for emergency medical needs, containing 20 essential first aid supplies. The heavy-duty canvas pouch features a U-shaped zipper opening for quick and easy access to the contents inside. Designed with a belt loop attachment, this first aid kit can be worn on your belt, allowing for hands-free carry and swift access while on the go. Ideal for EMTs or as a general first aid kit for home use, camping, hiking, or other outdoor activities, this compact kit ensures you’re prepared for minor medical emergencies. The kit is small enough to be stored in a larger medical bag or backpack, measuring just 4 3/4 inches x 3 1/2 inches x 1 3/4 inches. Refill contents can be purchased separately under Rothco item #1707. Note: This item is restricted for export and cannot be sold for use in some countries outside the U.S. Please contact Rothco for details. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
